import pandas as pd

customers = pd.read_csv("customers.csv", parse_dates=["signup_date"])
customers.info()

n_rows = len(customers)
n_countries = customers["country"].nunique()
top_country = customers["country"].value_counts().idxmax()
missing_referrals = customers["referred_by"].isna().sum()
first_signup = customers["signup_date"].min()
